note: Bulk reads over contract relations, each ordered, for replay through benchmarks/hostlab-b0-pipeline.py on any input. They are written for this adapter, not taken from HostLab's audit: they exercise open, session reuse, long results and full DTO consumption, and say nothing about HostLab's request mix. Replace with HostLab's recorded requests once MDD-005 has them. String values are not selected: on the public NewPipe 0.28.6 APK 19 of 68,476 strings contain NUL, which a DEX stores as the two bytes C0 80, and HostLab's strict UTF-8 decode of the hex cell refuses them ('malformed hex cell'). The adapter keeps that guard; whether the frozen A0 gives the same bytes for those strings was not checked. On large inputs the statements also need raised SQL budgets (--sql-max-*).

SELECT string_pool_id,string_idx FROM strings ORDER BY string_pool_id,string_idx
